page_title: Interested in Partnering up with ILPlatform?
page_description: Partner with ILPlatform to organise coding and robotics activities for children, with educators, curriculum support, material, and optional registration, marketing, and subsidy support.
title: Interested in Partnering up with ILPlatform?
subtitle: We work with schools and organisations to bring coding and robotics activities to children in a practical, well-structured way.

needs.title: What do you need?
items: A room with plugs and WiFi
A secure location to store the material

provides.title: What do we provide?
items: Material, including laptops and, when applicable, robots

items.title: Registration system
items.content: If useful for your school or organisation, registrations can go through our website.

items.title: Marketing support
items.content: We can help promote the joint activities to families and local communities.

items.title: Subsidy applications
items.content: We can support subsidy applications to help reduce the cost for parents.

programme.title: Programme
programme.content: Our programme is built around age-adapted coding and robotics activities, with projects designed to develop logical thinking, creativity, and confidence with technology.

schools.title: Schools already working with us
schools.content: We are already working with many schools in Brussels. Do you want to be the next one?
schools.map_fallback: The partner school map needs a Google Maps JavaScript API key before it can show multiple custom pins.

items.quote:
C’est avec grand plaisir que nous sommes partants pour poursuivre les cours l’an prochain.
Les enfants sont très enthousiastes pour ces cours.
items.author: Partner school
